text:
Maya: Heads up — noticed an invoice delta for tenant acme-inc, ~2.3% token uplift vs yesterday. :thinking_face:
Rahul: Any signal where attribution shifted? route tags or sampling?
Maya: I did a diff on billing events for a few runs — ~6k events in the last 2h are missing `x-route-id` and got routed to `default-route` (higher sku).
Jon: Any proxy or edge changes around that time?
DeployBot: deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-21_16:05 -> edge-proxy v2.3.4 completed (canary 10/100).
Ellie: Can you paste a sanitized event snippet so we can see the shape?
Maya: Example event snippet:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_...",
  "tenant_id": "acme-inc",
  "session_id": "sess_123",
  "tokens": 314,
  "headers": { "user-agent": "sdk/1.2.0" },
  "route_id": null
}
```
Rahul: That `route_id: null` is the smoking gun. My guess: the proxy's header canonicalization started turning absent `x-route-id` into an explicit null instead of leaving it unset, and the metering consumer treats null as missing -> default fallback.
Jon: I remember adding a small change in PR #1209 to collapse empty headers (`strip_empty_headers`). It ran in canary at 16:05.
Maya: @Jon can you check canary promotion timestamps? Our invoices show prod-level effects.
Jon: Canary was 10% and the rollout auto-promoted at 16:18 after health checks. I'm pausing and rolling back now.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollback triggered for edge-proxy v2.3.4 -> v2.3.3. Start: 16:25. Status: in progress.
Rahul: Short-term recon idea: retag events missing route_id by joining on session_id -> last known route mapping. Quick query to find candidates:
```sql
SELECT event_id FROM billing.events
WHERE route_id IS NULL AND session_id IN (
  SELECT session_id FROM sessions.route_map WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
)
```
Jon: Good. We should replay corrected events into `billing-repair` topic and run a dry-run invoice to estimate delta.
Ellie: Also we need console coverage: add an alert card when 'route-less events' > 0.5% and a dashboard card showing per-route attr rate over time. I'll open a console-ux ticket.
Maya: I'm starting a micro-recon job now to emit corrected events to `billing-repair`. Will post counts in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: incident 2026-03-21-68 created and alert suppressed; #incidents channel spawned.
Jon: Postmortem action items I'm noting: 1) revert `strip_empty_headers` default; 2) add an integration test that asserts no invoice delta >0.1% from header handling changes; 3) add a telemetry contract that explicitly verifies header preservation end-to-end. I'll draft PRs for 1 & 2.
Maya: Thanks team — keep updates small and paste numbers when the recon finishes.
